文学座はなぜ続くのか――Recreating Theatre Across Generations

文学座の89年余りの歴史を、famous actors や canonical plays の保存ではなく、the capacity to recreate theatre を次世代へ渡す問題として読む。Founding, two ruptures in 1963, the Atelier, the Institute, the supporters' association, and the 2021 funding crisis を一次資料と取材から考察する。Facts, hypotheses, and proposals are kept separate.
